text:
Aisha: hey folks, aisha here, first day on runtime. trying `bazel build //runtime:service_gpu` on ubuntu 24.04 with CUDA 11.8 and gcc-12. getting a ptxas error + later a relocation/fPIC complaint. any onboarding pointers?
Aisha: error snippets: 
```
ptxas fatal : ValueError: unsupported PTX version '8.8'
...
/usr/bin/ld: relocation R_X86_64_32 against `.rodata' can not be used when making a shared object; recompile with -fPIC
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
Mika: welcome! two quick things to check: `nvcc --version` and `nvidia-smi`. bazel sometimes picks up a different toolkit via toolchain settings. Also `which ptxas`
Aisha: nvcc -> 11.8.89, nvidia-smi shows Driver Version: 520.56.06 on this laptop, `which ptxas` -> /usr/local/cuda-11.8/bin/ptxas
Natanael: driver 520.x likely doesn't handle PTX 8.8 emitted by some newer components. For fPIC, add `-Xcompiler -fPIC` to NVCC flags or set bazel's cc_toolchain to compile with -fPIC for shared objects.
Mika: on bazel builds add to your .bazelrc or invoke: `bazel build --action_env=CUDA_NVCC_FLAGS="-Xcompiler -fPIC -gencode=arch=compute_70,code=sm_70" //runtime:service_gpu` which forces older PTX and PIC.
Aisha: tried that, build progressed past ptxas, then hit missing symbol `cublasLtMatmul` at runtime when running smoke test locally
Natanael: that's the classic host-driver mismatch. If you can't upgrade drivers on your laptop, use the infra dev VM or CI runners for GPU tests. infra-bot can show recommended image for builds.
infra-bot: Recommended image: registry.redwood/internal/runtime-dev:cuda11.8-gcc12-bazel-2026-03-12. CI GPU runners use driver >= 525.85. See /internal/runbooks/runtime-gpu-runners.md
Aisha: ok using bazel flags + NVCC PIC got the build artifacts. i'll run GPU tests on CI. i'll also add a short note to eng-runtime onboarding: bazel flags example, NVCC fPIC, and driver min version. thanks!
Mika: great, welcome aboard Aisha :wave: ping me for a quick walkthrough of the bazel toolchain config if you want.
